# Two Case Studies and a Capstone, First

In the single book these three chapters come last, because they
apply every earlier part. Here, at the front of Volume 1, they are
a preview of where the book is going, and you are not expected to
work through them yet. Nothing here assumes you have read the
chapters that follow. Each tool they use is named as it appears,
with a pointer to the chapter that teaches it, in this volume or in
Volume 2 or 3. You may skip this part and return to it once you
have finished the rest of the book. Alternatively, read it now for
the motivation and skim past what does not yet make sense.

- @sec-penguins works a complete analysis on the Palmer penguins
  data and maps each step to the chapter that taught it.
- @sec-adni works a harder case, prediction of conversion from mild
  cognitive impairment, with data held under a data-use agreement.
- @sec-synthesis takes the HF-HOME study from a multi-site
  case-report-form export to a deposited compendium with a tagged
  analysis plan, executed tests, continuous integration, a one-page
  memo, and a response to a reviewer.

There is no quiz for this part. Read as much or as little as helps.
